rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Prime Minister's statement dated 5 April 2000, under the heading 森内閣総理大臣演説等, says that he was appointed Prime Minister that day (本日、内閣総理大臣に任命され) and formed a coalition cabinet with Komeito-Kaikaku Club and the Conservative Party, asking the previous cabinet's ministers to continue; it refers to 小渕前内閣総理大臣.
